text: Good afternoon. I'm calling this meeting of the Student Behavior and Accountability Committee to order. This meeting is to hear a student discipline appeal. My name is Dr. Linda Deans and I am chairing this meeting. With me are April Chandler, Algonquian District Representative,

and Lauren Chernoff, Leesburg District Rep. Thank you. I would now like to call for a motion to move this meeting into closed session. I motion to move this meeting to closed session. Second. The motion

has been seconded. I move that the Student Behavior and Accountability Committee of the Loughton County School Board leave the public meeting and enter into a closed meeting pursuant to section 2.2-3712 of the Code of Virginia for the following purposes. Discussion or consideration of a recommendation for disciplining one student enrolled in Loughton County Public Schools

as authorized by section 2.2-3711, section A-2 of the Code of Virginia. So I've heard a motion and a second. All in favor, let it be sent by saying aye. Aye. All who oppose, nay. The committee approves the motion to move into closed session by a unanimous vote. I move that the closed meeting be adjourned, that the Student Behavior and Accountability Committee of the Lawton County

School Board reconvene its public meeting, and that the minutes of the public meeting reflect that no formal action was taken in the closed meeting. Is there a second? Second. The motion has been seconded. All in favor, aye. Aye. Anyone who are against, nay. The committee approves the motion to adjourn the closed session by unanimous vote. I move that the following resolution

certifying the closed meeting be adopted and reflected in the minutes of this public meeting. Resolution 18-23-24. Whereas the Student Behavior and Accountability Committee of the Lawton County School Board has convened a closed meeting on this date pursuant to an affirmative recorded vote and in accordance with the provisions of the Virginia Freedom of Information Act and whereas section 2.2-3712 section d of the code of Virginia requires a certification

by this committee of the school board that such closed meeting was conducted in conformity with Virginia law. Now, therefore, be it resolved that the Student Behavior and Accountability Committee of the Loudoun County School Board hereby certifies that, to the best of each member's knowledge, only public business matters lawfully exempted from open meeting requirements by Virginia law were discussed in the executive meeting to which this certification applies

and two only such public business matters that were identified in the motion convening the closed meeting were heard discussed or considered by the school behavior and accountability committee of the Loughton County School Board is there a second second the motion has been seconded all in favor say aye. Aye. All who oppose, nay. The committee approves the motion by a vote of unanimous, by a
unanimous vote to certify the closed session. Regarding appeal case OSA 02-23-24, I move to affirm the student disciplinary decision made by the hearing officer for student appeal case number
OSA02-23-24. Do I hear a second? Second. It has been moved and properly seconded that the motion is carried. All in favor say aye. Aye. All who against say nay. The committee approves

the motion by a unanimous vote. I move the Student Behavior and Accountability Committee's findings and decisions will be included in a report and reflected in the minutes of this public meeting. There is no other business before this committee. I move to adjourn the meeting. Is there

a second? Second. The motion has been seconded. All in favor, aye. Aye. Aye. Anyone who are against, nay. The committee approves the motion to adjourn by unanimous vote. Let the record reflect that The meeting adjourned at 3.15, 3.16 p.m.
